body: [@Ramsey](/edgeware/account/k43sLKozrmQq7d7aqpYCzqiUM7DJgMaMrVsrY1uPQvpZLWT) Can you give a few example use cases for what you're proposing?

Sounds exciting... few questions given we (decent partners) are also developing some music oriented projects for Edgeware and hopefully Kabocha - and specifically because this is introduced to the Edgeware community. 

> Kabocha Music is the arm of the Kabocha (and Edgeware) community that focuses on the music industry. We aim to make decentralised waves in music through our playground of possibilities grassroots development approach to collaboration, projects and funding.

Given Kabocha is, like Edgeware, a result of the things we approve funding for and agree to push forward, is this not a 'Decentration' proposal for 'Kabocha music' rather than a 'Kabocha project'. If the community approves spend, then it moves from an idea to something concrete. 

It might seem like semantics, but these delineations are really important going forward as we try to make our story more structured and our processes easier to understand in the core community and indeed for newcomers. 

Following on from this - is the first proposal going to be put to Edgeware first for its R&D phase before being picked up by Kabocha for the commercial pilot? 

In the end this structure gives us a clear and consistent value proposition for both EDG and KAB - with Edgeware recouping KAB for R&D picked up by Kabocha.

As with every contributing team, its entirely open to make the best case for how these things work and our standards are emerging organically so interested to hear your thoughts.
